understanding.goal_understanding: Progress through all KA59 levels and win each level by placing every selectable piece onto goal tiles marked '+' in the semantic grid; if there are multiple goals, all must be occupied simultaneously for the level (and ultimately the full run) to report WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: The currently controlled piece is identified by player.id and player.position; movement actions shift it one grid cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction unless blocked or altered by interactions. Walls (#) act as obstacles that can prevent movement, though some boundaries may behave inconsistently and require probing; the movement.*_blocked flags only indicate adjacency and are not a definitive failure signal. Pushable objects (blocks B) can be moved if they are directly adjacent in the movement direction and have space to slide, in which case the selected piece pushes them along. When multiple selectables exist, control is switched using CLICK with a target_position matching the exact pixel/grid coordinates of the desired selectable as listed in objects/selectables or shown in the state.

understanding.goal_understanding: Progress through all KA59 levels and win each level by placing every selectable piece onto goal tiles marked '+' in the semantic grid; if there are multiple goals, all must be occupied simultaneously for the level (and ultimately the full run) to report WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: The currently controlled piece is identified by player.id and player.position; movement actions shift it one grid cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction unless blocked or altered by interactions. Walls (#) act as obstacles that can prevent movement, though some boundaries may behave inconsistently and require probing; the movement.*_blocked flags only indicate adjacency and are not a definitive failure signal. Pushable objects (blocks B) can be moved if they are directly adjacent in the movement direction and have space to slide, in which case the selected piece pushes them along. When multiple selectables exist, control is switched using CLICK with a target_position matching the exact pixel/grid coordinates of the desired selectable as listed in objects/selectables or shown in the state.
